collate_tokens: create a padded 2D tensor from a list of 1D tensors with configurable left padding and EOS handling
normalize_answer: normalize text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace for answer comparison
simplify_dpr_data: simplify DPR retrieval data by extracting questions, answers, positive contexts, and hard negative contexts
combine: combine HotpotQA and Natural Questions datasets into a unified training and validation format
combine_corpus: merge HotpotQA and DPR Wikipedia corpora into a single deduplicated corpus with intro passage markers
